title: Create an ASIC Connect account
summary: This page explains how to create an ASIC Connect account to manage business names or approved self-managed superannuation fund (SMSF) auditor registrations.
intro:
ASIC Connect is an online service you can use to manage your business name or approved self-managed superannuation fund (SMSF) auditor registration. Services available include:

Once you've created your ASIC Connect account, you can request an ASIC key which enables you to link your business name and conduct your transactions.

If you have a few business names, you can manage them all from the same account.
